caption_linkedin:
Transparency is a legal right in India. Under the Right to Information Act, 2005, any citizen can seek information from a public authority:

• Apply to the Public Information Officer (PIO) of the office concerned; central government bodies accept applications online at rtionline.gov.in
• The fee for central public authorities is ₹10; applicants below the poverty line pay no fee (with a BPL certificate)
• The PIO must reply within 30 days, or within 48 hours where the information concerns a person's life or liberty
• If there is no reply or you are not satisfied, a first appeal lies within 30 days to the First Appellate Authority, with no fee
• A second appeal can be filed with the Information Commission within 90 days

RTI is a powerful tool for citizens, businesses and researchers alike. For help drafting an application or appeal, you can consult a Bar Council-verified advocate on AdvocateSetu: https://advocatesetu.com

For general awareness only. Not legal advice.
